      "records": "SELECT\n    (CASE source_file\n    WHEN 'openstack_abnormal' THEN CAST(1000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal1' THEN CAST(2000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal2' THEN CAST(3000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    ELSE NULL END + line_no) AS record_id,\n    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS event_id,\n    ts AS timestamp,\n    component,\n    level AS severity,\n    message,\n    request_id,\n    instance_id,\n    service,\n    http_status,\n    latency_s,\n    is_anomaly\nFROM openstack_logs\nWHERE (CASE source_file\n    WHEN 'openstack_abnormal' THEN CAST(1000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal1' THEN CAST(2000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal2' THEN CAST(3000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    ELSE NULL END + line_no) IN (SELECT (CASE source_file\n    WHEN 'openstack_abnormal' THEN CAST(1000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal1' THEN CAST(2000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal2' THEN CAST(3000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    ELSE NULL END + line_no) FROM openstack_logs_idx WHERE message @@ %(text)s) AND\n    level = %(severity)s\nORDER BY ts, (CASE source_file\n    WHEN 'openstack_abnormal' THEN CAST(1000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal1' THEN CAST(2000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal2' THEN CAST(3000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    ELSE NULL END + line_no)\nLIMIT %(fetch_limit)s",
      "total_count": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_corpus_match_count\nFROM openstack_logs\nWHERE (CASE source_file\n    WHEN 'openstack_abnormal' THEN CAST(1000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal1' THEN CAST(2000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal2' THEN CAST(3000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    ELSE NULL END + line_no) IN (SELECT (CASE source_file\n    WHEN 'openstack_abnormal' THEN CAST(1000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal1' THEN CAST(2000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    WHEN 'openstack_normal2' THEN CAST(3000000000 AS BIGINT)\n    ELSE NULL END + line_no) FROM openstack_logs_idx WHERE message @@ %(text)s) AND\n    level = %(severity)s"
